name: OpenCEP
operator: OpenCEP (opencep.com): static CEP JSON files served from Google Cloud Storage behind Cloudflare; operator not identified in the research
tier_rationale: Not reviewed yet: 'OpenCEP is used only after the registry reviewer records it as community tier; while it is unknown it receives no value (unknown tier receives IOC values only) and the chain ends at ViaCEP.' (P234 cond 4). Evidence for the reviewer: static ViaCEP-compatible JSON on Google Cloud Storage (31-day cache), already relayed by BrasilAPI CEP v2 (backend 'open-cep'), and a live data-quality defect (2026-11-26: HTTP 200 with a Sarandi-PR street for the non-existent CEP 99999-999).

reliability.justification: Unreviewed static mirror of CEP data; answered a non-existent CEP (99999-999) with a real street on 2026-11-26, so its answers are checked against the offline CEP range table before use.

cep.title: OpenCEP /v1/{cep} (ViaCEP-compatible subset)

terms.quote: public open data / free public API

cep.notes: Research C0577 terms 'public open data / free public API'. Not declared by any module while the tier is unknown (P234 cond 4): cep_lookup keeps the parser and the chain slot and adds this source once the registry reviewer records tier community. Not found = HTTP 404 {'error': true} (a vote, not a final verdict).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G10-1 (P234 cep_lookup). Registered so the host has an owner and the tier review has a place to land; no module receives values through it until then.
